integrity: All stated proof and numerical checks are self-reviewed research evidence. The auxiliary 79,629 finite diagnostics do not certify infinitely many parameters. No independent audit or priority determination has been performed.
scientific_limitations: One-variable Gaussian Fock space; factors must themselves be affine composition operators admitting individual bounded-symbol Toeplitz representations. No assertion about arbitrary Toeplitz products. The precise single-factor recognition theorem is external prior input; equivalence to older complex-semigroup geometry remains a literature risk.
title: Sharp factor lengths for Toeplitz-representable affine Fock composition operators
